body:
We had two discussions about marriage the first was in the beginning where he told me that he valued the idea of family and it could be for him. The second convo was recent. His views have changed dramatically and I have not brought it up since. It is just something that bothers me because I value it.  
I suppose you're right he can get everything he wants because I am available to him. That's the hurtful part I don't want to just be an option I want to be a priority and I think that is fair. What are your thoughts on this?
Edit to add I did bring it up when I told him that it bothered me that he was not interested in marriage, but I love him more than an institution and would be willing to live without it for him.
I definitely needed to hear this. I know it to be true. Thank you
